entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Diana, I want to return this garbage jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide your order number?

Look, don't give me the runaround. I know how this works. I got this thing 19 days ago, and your website is probably going to give me some garbage excuse. The jersey is the wrong size, it's way too tight, and I want my money back or an exchange, now!
I understand your frustration, and I want to assure you I'm here to help resolve this. I just need the order number to pull up your account and see the return options available.
Fine! It's VF-8675309. You'd better not tell me I'm out of luck or I'm lighting you up on every review site on the planet. I want to speak to your manager if this takes more than two minutes.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series jersey. And you mentioned it was the wrong size?
Yes, it's too tight! I can barely breathe in it. I need to exchange it for a Large.
That's absolutely no problem at all. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return policy. I can process an exchange for you right now and email you a pre-paid return label for the original jersey.
Oh. So... it's fine? You're just going to do it?

Yes, of course. I've just processed the exchange for the same jersey in a size Large. You should receive an email with the return shipping label in the next five minutes. Just pack the original item, attach the label, and drop it off. We'll ship the new size out as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier.
Huh. Okay. Well... good. That's what you should do.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
